# HDF5

`jaff.drivers.HDF5`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

High-level HDF5 read/write driver backed by `h5py`.

Provides methods to convert between `HDF5Dict` and
HDF5 files, and to export HDF5 data to CSV.

## Constructor

`#!python HDF5(compression=None)`

**Parameters**

**compression** : _str or None, optional_
: HDF5 compression filter (e.g. `"gzip"`).  `None` disables
    compression.  Defaults to `None`.

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`to_dict`](to_dict.md) | Load an HDF5 file (or sub-group) into a nested `HDF5Dict`. |
| [`from_dict`](from_dict.md) | Write an `HDF5Dict` to an HDF5 file. |
| [`to_csv`](to_csv.md) | Export all datasets from an HDF5 file to CSV files under *outdir*. |
